disclaimer: The packet counts reruns only. Necessary and sufficient are relative to the final selection, which is a local minimum; there is no causal proof and the interpretation requires human review.

hypotheses.text: The failure may require the combined workspace perturbation from all four moved objects (alphabet_soup_1, cream_cheese_1, milk_1, orange_juice_1) plus the robot joint offsets to push the policy out of its success basin. Test: revert orange_juice_1 to reference (0%) while keeping the other four at their final fractions (alphabet_soup_1 87.5%, cream_cheese_1 100%, milk_1 100%, robot 87.5%) to see if failure persists.

Cream_cheese_1 and milk_1 were never shrink-tested; their full 100% offsets might be larger than necessary. Test: shrink cream_cheese_1 position to 87.5% (keeping alphabet_soup_1 87.5%, milk_1 100%, orange_juice_1 100%, robot 87.5%) to check if failure still reproduces.

Robot joints at 87.5% are necessary but not sufficient; the critical joint subset is unknown. Test: apply only the three largest joint offsets (joint4 2.64°, joint2 2.13°, joint5 2.53°) at 87.5% with the four objects at final fractions to see if a smaller joint set suffices.

limitations: Result is a local minimum from a limited number of reruns on one task and one start pair; the reduction stopped early due to budget exhaustion.
Necessary and sufficient are relative to the final selection found; other smaller combinations may exist that were not explored.
No causal proof is provided; the evidence shows statistical association only, and human review is required before drawing conclusions.

observations.text: The hypothesis ranked alphabet_soup_1 first and robot third; measured confirms both are necessary (removing either from the final selection stops the failure) but neither is sufficient alone (c2, c4). Tomato_sauce_1 was ranked second but is not in the final minimal selection and was not sufficient alone (c3).

The final minimal selection requires five components together: alphabet_soup_1 position at 87.5%, cream_cheese_1 position at 100%, milk_1 position at 100%, orange_juice_1 position at 100%, and robot joints at 87.5%. Removing any one (c12, c19) restores success; the full combination reproduces failure (c32).

Shrink tests show alphabet_soup_1 position and robot joints each fail at 87.5% but not at 75% or below; orange_juice_1 position fails at 100% but not at 87.5% or below. Cream_cheese_1 and milk_1 were kept at 100% without shrink testing before budget exhaustion.

The passing reference start with only these differences applied (alphabet_soup_1 position 100%, cream_cheese_1 position 100%, milk_1 position 100%, orange_juice_1 position 100%); every other entity at the reference: S S S (0 of 3 attempts failed), so this scene does NOT reproduce the failure (the task mostly succeeded).

The passing reference start with only these differences applied (alphabet_soup_1 position 87.5%, cream_cheese_1 position 100%, milk_1 position 100%, orange_juice_1 position 100%, robot joints 87.5%); every other entity at the reference: S F F F F (4 of 5 attempts failed), so this scene DOES reproduce the failure.

hypothesis.text: The alphabet soup moved 2.89 cm, the largest object shift, likely placing it outside the policy's learned grasp envelope or into collision with the basket (also shifted 2.16 cm). The tomato sauce moved 0.7 cm, which may be enough to miss a tight grasp tolerance. I predict that reverting only the alphabet soup to its reference pose will restore success, while reverting only the tomato sauce will not.

minimal.sentence: Moving alphabet_soup_1 by 2.5 cm (of the original 2.9 cm), moving cream_cheese_1 by 1.1 cm (of the original 1.1 cm), moving milk_1 by 2.4 cm (of the original 2.4 cm), moving orange_juice_1 by 3.7 cm (of the original 3.7 cm) and moving 6 joints of robot 88% of the way to their failing values are enough to make the policy fail from the passing start 28 (at least 4 of 5 attempts); sizes are resolved to within 1/8 of the original difference; the reduction stopped early, so this is the smallest cause found so far.
shrink: alphabet_soup_1 position: 87.5% of the difference still fails; 75% and smaller sizes on the way were already tested and did not reproduce the failure.
robot joints: 87.5% of the difference still fails; 75% and smaller sizes on the way were already tested and did not reproduce the failure.
orange_juice_1 position: 100% of the difference still fails; 87.5% and smaller sizes on the way were already tested and did not reproduce the failure.
cream_cheese_1: kept at its full difference; its size was not shrunk before the reduction stopped (untested).
milk_1: kept at its full difference; its size was not shrunk before the reduction stopped (untested).
